reasons: Both answers propose nearly identical staged pipelines: a deterministic pre-filter, per-PR JSON extraction with an evidence-backed rollout field, grouping by feature key using the most conservative status, a constrained writer, code-based coverage and GA checks, and a PM review of intermediate lists, along with Batch API and small-model cost measures and a golden-set evaluation. A is slightly stricter on omissions (it truncates in code and never lets the model choose what to drop), while B adds an explicit omitted_with_reason list, a writer retry loop, and a rule that GA language must match rollout status. Neither difference is enough to separate them decisively.
